character.name: Colonel Zhang Mao
character.description: The younger of the Zhang twins, Zhang Mao's gifts also mani-fested early. But while his brother became a warrior, he became a social adept. Peaceful and thoughtful by nature, Zhang Mao attended the Harvard Business School in the UCAS and earned his Master's degree in international finance. When his father became ill, Zhang Mao joined the Fifty-Eighth out of a sense of duty. Using his talents, Zhang Mao secured several lucrative contracts for the Fifty-Eighth and ran the logistical department like a well-lubricated machine. But for all of his skills, Zhang Mao never tried to be a warrior, despite pressure to assume command once his father passed. Zhang Mao now remains out of a sense of duty, repulsed at what his father's work has become, and he is secretly looking to find ways for the Fifty-Eighth to break free of his brother's and the Triad's grasp.
